packagesTitle: From checking the problem to your own tool

packages.name: Diagnosis with a prototype
packages.forWhom: When you know something isn’t working, but not yet what to build.
items: Interviews with the people doing the work
Problem map and a recommended scope
Clickable prototype to show your team

packages.name: Product sprint
packages.forWhom: When you know what to improve in your product and want it in a working version.
items: Analysis of one area, such as onboarding or checkout
Change in the product, or a ready spec for your team

packages.name: A tool for your company
packages.forWhom: When a process needs its own app and today runs on spreadsheets and email.
items: Working app for one specific process
Data moved over from your current files
Rollout with your team and fixes after launch

steps.title: Conversation
steps.text: 15 minutes about the problem. If it's not for me, I'll say so right away.

steps.title: Understanding the problem
steps.text: I talk to the people who work with the product. Together we agree what should change and by when.

steps.title: Working versions
steps.text: You regularly see something you can click and check. After launch we improve it based on real use.

priceNote: I quote every scope after a short call, once I know what you are bringing. Price and scope are confirmed in writing before we start.
